verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sprinto manages several frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS) in one place and mentions "pre-mapped controls." It never documents controls or evidence being cross-mapped between frameworks, SOC 2 work counting automatically toward ISO 27001 or HIPAA, or any view of framework overlap. Managing multiple frameworks side by side is an adjacent capability, not the cross-framework mapping this story asks for.

support.subject: As a security engineer, controls and evidence map ACROSS frameworks — work done for SOC 2 counts toward ISO 27001 and HIPAA automatically, with the overlap shown
